scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: Press the accelerator, and tiny explosions push a car down the road. How does an engine turn fuel into motion?

scenes.name: piston
scenes.text: Inside are cylinders, each with a piston that slides up and down, connected to a crankshaft.

scenes.name: intake
scenes.text: Step one, intake. The piston moves down, drawing in air and fuel.

scenes.name: compress
scenes.text: Step two, compression. The piston moves up, squeezing the mixture tight.

scenes.name: power
scenes.text: Step three, power. A spark plug ignites it, and the blast pushes the piston down hard.

scenes.name: exhaust
scenes.text: Step four, exhaust. The piston rises again, pushing the burnt gases out the tailpipe.

scenes.name: crank
scenes.text: The crankshaft turns all that up and down motion into rotation, which goes through the gearbox to the wheels.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Intake, compression, power, exhaust. Suck, squeeze, bang, blow. Follow for more on how things really work.
